reason: $59 a month is a lot on our budget when the library and the park are free, and I would have to drive in from Fruitland. A $12 drop-in is the only thing I might try, but I would not commit to it up front.
objection: Ages 8 months to 5 all in one room. Is my baby going to get run over by bigger kids? Nothing here says there is a separate baby area.
would_change_my_mind: A separate, gated baby and toddler area, plus a free or cheap first visit so I can see how wild it gets before paying anything.
